parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to detach all tags. Valid values: **true** and **false**. Default value: **false**.

> This parameter takes effect only when the `TagKey.n` parameter is empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> Call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to view available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the target cluster.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **cluster**.
